Episode: Mega Evolution |plaintitle=Pocket Monsters Episode: Mega Evolution |image=HZ Mega Evolution logo.png |size=240px |arc=Arc |number=6 |ending=YUU |numeps=3 ([[HZ112]]-[[HZ114]]) |region=[[Kalos]] |series=''[[Pokémon Horizons: The Series]]'' |prevlink=Mega Voltage |prev=Pocket Monsters: Mega Voltage |nextlink=Rising Again |next=Pocket Monsters: Rising Again |seo= }} (Japanese: '''ポケットモンスター エピソード：メガシンカ''' ''Pocket Monsters Episode: Mega Evolution'') is a three-episode special arc of {{aniseries|HZ}} that aired from October 10, 2025, to October 24, 2025, coinciding with the release of [[Pokémon Legends: Z-A]]. These episodes take place during the one-year timeskip between the ''[[Rayquaza Rising]]'' and ''[[Mega Voltage]]'' arcs and focus on [[Roy]] and [[Ult]] and their journey to master [[Mega Evolution]], serving as a flashback arc that explores their past encounters with the powerful transformation. They are primarily set in [[Lumiose City]] in the [[Kalos]] region, with the [[Prism Tower]] serving as a prominent location in the trailer. The episodes will also feature [[Emma]], a resident of Lumiose City, and [[Master Mayonnaise]], a mysterious man in armor. The theme song for the arc is [[YUU]], performed by {{wp|Yuzu (band)|Yuzu}}, who previously performed [[GET BACK]] for the ''Mega Voltage'' arc. The arc was announced on August 22, 2025, and the episodes aired in {{pmin|Japan}} on [[TV Tokyo]] for three consecutive weeks from October 10 to October 24, 2025, and were released for streaming exclusively on [[Prime Video]].[https://twitter.com/anipoke_PR/status/1976830113057849820 アニメ「ポケットモンスター」公式 (@anipoke_PR) on X/Twitter, Oct 11, 2025][https://youtu.be/afdPACmJcGo 『ポケットモンスター エピソード：メガシンカ』見放題《独占》配信決定！ | プライムビデオ] via [https://www.youtube.com/@PrimeVideoJP Prime Video JP - プライムビデオ] on [[YouTube]]. In the {{pmin|Taiwan}}ese Mandarin and {{pmin|Hong Kong}} Cantonese dubs, they were released as special episodes on the Traditional Chinese Pokémon YouTube channel from October 10 to 24, 2025. In the {{pmin|Korea}}n dub, they aired on JEI 재능TV from October 14 to 27, 2025, and were released for streaming on [[Netflix]], {{wp|Wavve}}, and {{wp|TVING}} on February 12, 2026.[https://twitter.com/AnipokemonKorea/status/2022143715213816195 포켓몬 애니 공식 채널 (@AnipokemonKorea) on X/Twitter, February 13, 2026] In the {{pmin|English}} dub, the episodes were first released in
